title: Seventeen votes, a larger total: what share?
hook: Prussia keeps 17 votes as the total rises from 43 to 58. What happens to its share?

knows: A fraction has a numerator and denominator.
doesNotKnow: Recompute Prussia’s share from the actual 1867 and 1871 Bundesrat vote schedules.

misconception: An unchanged numerator means an unchanged share.
objective: Recompute Prussia’s share from the actual 1867 and 1871 Bundesrat vote schedules.
